gaps.sentence: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
gaps.explanation: would rather + somebody + past simple: I'd rather you didn't smoke.

gaps.sentence: We can't risk ___ the connection flight.
I remembered ___ the door, so I went back to check.
gaps.explanation: remember + -ing = recall a past action; remember to do = not forget a duty.

gaps.sentence: She was the first woman ___ the peak in winter.
gaps.explanation: the first/second/last + to-infinitive: the first woman to climb.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: We stopped at a village ___ some lunch.
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do something: stopped to have lunch.

gaps.sentence: She forgot ___ the email, so she sent it twice.
gaps.explanation: forget + -ing = lose the memory of a past action (she did send it).
